classification.conformanceProfile: RFC 9639 native FLAC bounded 16-bit mono/stereo PCM profile

contractSchema.claim: audio object contract is valid under audio-flac-contract-v1

referenceIntegrity.claim: reference FLAC implementation decodes/tests the complete stream without error

streamInfo.claim: native STREAMINFO technical facts and decoded-audio MD5 satisfy the object contract and R1 profile

metadataBlockPolicy.claim: all FLAC metadata block types are within the bounded R1 allow-list

decoderMatrix.claim: reference FLAC decoder and independent FFmpeg decoder produce exactly identical canonical s16le PCM bytes

independentTechnicalView.claim: FFprobe independently identifies native FLAC and agrees on sample rate, channels, bit depth and sample count

pcmIdentity.claim: STREAMINFO MD5 matches canonical decoded PCM MD5 and any contract expectedPcmSha256 matches decoded PCM SHA-256

nonClaims: factual or artistic correctness of the audio content
truth or completeness of Vorbis comments/tags
semantics of metadata block families excluded from R1
preservation-policy compliance beyond the bounded RFC 9639/profile checks
absence of clipping, silence, phase issues or other signal-quality defects
